ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Press Release — Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 25, 2026, titled "Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited s 1:10 Share Split Takes Effect, Shares Commenced Trading on Ex-Split Basis on August 25 ahead of August 26 Record date".

Press Release — Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 12, 2026, titled "Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited Shareholders Approve 1:10 Share Split; Record Date Fixed for August 26, 2026".
Record Date — Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Split/Subdivision  is 26-Aug-2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.

Stock split — Waterways Leisure Tourism Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on July 10, 2026, has considered and approved subdivision of 1 equity shares of Rs. 10 each into 10 equity shares of Re. 1 each.
